name: French Quality Share-Alike Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed French quality recipe composite over the policy-expanded French component graph, including share-alike isolated lexical, morphology, syntax, and search evidence.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated share-alike recipe composite over publishable French core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, morphology, syntax, search, KB, corpus, and parallel components, with required component reports and evaluation evidence for the full policy-expanded French graph.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Required component source rows are approved and either default-compatible, attribution-compatible, or share-alike isolated. Lexique 3.83, UniMorph French, and UD French GSD remain isolated behind the required -sa package policy surface.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: French share-alike resource-quality component composite for the generated policy-expanded French graph. It does not claim permissive default-package compatibility, WOLF/OMW wordnet coverage, OPUS coverage, corpus-scale French quality baselines, readability scoring, OCR/noisy-text diagnostics, annotation adjudication, or non-share-alike redistribution.
